title: Binance Will List Moonriver (MOVR)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Moonriver (MOVR)  and will open trading for  MOVR/BTC ,  MOVR/BNB ,  MOVR/BUSD , and  MOVR/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-11-08 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  MOVR  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for MOVR will open at 2021-11-09 06:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Moonriver (MOVR)? Moonriver is an EVM-compatible blockchain that operates as a parachain on the Kusama network. The network offers developers features including the ability to deploy Solidity smart contracts, Web3-compatible API, oracle data feeds, and Ethereum network bridges. MOVR is the utility and governance token of the network, which can be used for network governance, pay transaction fees, earning rewards through providing liquidity and staking.
